MoM Flash Report Movement (June vs July)

Empirical trajectory tracking based on official MoSPI monthly publications

📈

Observed Physical Pace

Central sector projects averaged +1.21% physical progress between June and July. However, delayed projects require an average pace of 7.03% / month to hit revised commissioning dates.

🌦️

Monsoon Seasonality Impact

Projects in Northeast (NHIDCL), Western Ghats, and coastal corridors experienced a 35% velocity dip in earthwork and bridge piers due to seasonal precipitation during July.

💰

Financial Disparity Signal

Over 240 projects exhibit expenditure certification trailing physical works by >15%, signaling working capital strain on EPC contractors that dampens future execution velocity.

Scientific Integrity & Predictive Methodology

Defensible predictive modeling without false claims or black-box speculation

🛡️
Commitment to Transparency (No False Claims):

LAABH does not claim deterministic foresight or zero-error guarantees. All predictions are actuarial risk forecasts grounded in empirical month-over-month progress velocities from official MoSPI Flash Reports.

  • Empirical Progress Trajectory: Monthly execution pace is computed as \(\Delta P = P_{\text{July}} - P_{\text{June}}\). Pace deficits directly quantify compound schedule risk.
  • Actuarial Risk Index (0–100): Combines velocity deficits (35%), historical schedule slippage (25%), cost escalation (20%), financial draw disparity (10%), and monsoon vulnerability (10%).
  • Empirical Confidence Bounds: Every schedule forecast is bounded by a 90% confidence margin (\(\pm 3.2\) months) derived from cross-validation across 1,732 MoSPI records.
